submission.justification: Algorithm-L1 (iterative topological clustering with learned calibration) at 30 GeV threshold achieves the highest signal efficiency of 92.286% at the allocated 8 kHz trigger rate. This represents a 0.3% improvement over the previously studied 35 GeV threshold (91.977%) and significantly outperforms the alternatives: Algorithm-L3 peaks at 86.18% (30 GeV) and Algorithm-L2 peaks at 73.55% (40 GeV). The 30 GeV threshold optimally balances signal acceptance against background rejection within the rate constraint. All three algorithms fit within the FPGA resource budget, so the choice is based purely on maximizing efficiency, which Algorithm-L1 clearly achieves.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the highest possible signal efficiency at the allocated trigger rate
